lessons.indian-english: hi-only lesson (profile hi.md §8 'add' / §4.11 / §9): Indian English usages that are normal in India but puzzle listeners abroad (prepone, out of station, good name, passed out, revert, years back, mention not, shifting), forms wrong in any variety (Myself Rahul, discuss about, I have a doubt, Do one thing) and Hindi calques (see a picture, eat my head, I belong to); placed after smalltalk via profile.json lessonOrder.after; deck 21 «इंडियन इंग्लिश: भारत बनाम विदेश»; no ko-en counterpart (mirrors zh chinglish)
lessons.stative-since: hi-only lesson (profile hi.md §8 add, §4.2): states vs actions with the continuous (I am knowing ✗, He is having a car ✗), Hindi से → since / for / from, and से + रहा है → Present Perfect (states) or Present Perfect Continuous (actions), How long…? for कब से. The most Hindi-specific grammar zone (Khan 2021; Demszky et al. STATIVE PROGRESSIVE; Van Rooy 2014); ko-en has no such lesson. New English side (checks and practice written for this course, practice meets the article-plural standing rule). Placed after perfect-2 (profile.json lessonOrder.after), deck अपना परिचय (deck 2, the deck of perfect-2).
